PC10-002.name: BARNABY BROOKS Jr. ［3］
PC10-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Barnaby"/"BARNABY BROOKS Jr.", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Nexus with one symbol or less. After this effect resolves, you can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "WILD TIGER" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

PC10-005.name: Kaburagi Kaede
PC10-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can summon one of your Cost 6 or less "Kaburagi T. Kotetsu"/"WILD TIGER" that is in Hand/Soul State, treating all reduction symbol as fulfilled. When you've done so, you can put a core from the Void to any of your "NEXT" family Spirits.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By exhausting this Nexus, activate an effect that includes (When Advents) as its effect timing of a Cost 6 or less "NEXT" family Spirit you control.

PC10-X01.name: Kaburagi T. Kotetsu & Barnaby Brooks Jr. ［2］
PC10-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add one "WILD TIGER"/"BARNABY BROOKS Jr."/"Double Chaser"/"Saito-san"/"Kaburagi Kaede"/"Mattia Ingram"/"Hyper Good Luck Mode" among them to the Hand. By paying one cost, change the "one" written in this effect to "one of each". Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2]
While your Life is at three or less, you can [Advent] your "WILD TIGER & BARNABY BROOKS Jr." onto this Spirit, ignoring conditions.

PC10-003.name: L.L. Audun
PC10-003.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, if there is a total of 17 or more cards in your Trash and the opposing Trash, this card becomes Cost 5.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This heavily exhausted Spirit gains +10000 BP, and can't be destroyed, or be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By heavily exhausting this Spirit, this Spirit is fixed as having two Purple symbols.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
This Spirit can refresh.

PC10-006.name: Mattia Ingram
PC10-006.effect:
This card's reduction symbol is also treated as Green.

[LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) When your "NEXT" family Spirit [advents], you can draw a card.

[LV2]
Increase the limit of your "NEXT" family Spirits' "BP Destruction effects" by +3000. Also, when activating your "BARNABY BROOKS Jr."'s effect that targets one opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus, you can change the target to two.

PC10-004.name: Saito-san
PC10-004.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Nexuses would leave the Field, or become heavily exhausted due to your effects or your Spirits, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash any of your "NEXT" family Spirits.

[LV1]
When your "WILD TIGER"/"BARNABY BROOKS Jr." would leave the Field due to the opponent, besides [Soul Core], by sending three cores from your Trash to the Void, up to two of those Spirits remain on the Field in the same condition.

PC10-X02.name: WILD TIGER & BARNABY BROOKS Jr. ［2］
PC10-X02.effect:
When your Spirits that are during Contract Advent would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit, and destroy an opposing Spirit/Nexus with two symbols or less.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Either put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit/Nexus, or draw a card.

PC10-001.name: WILD TIGER ［3］
PC10-001.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kotetsu"/"WILD TIGER", (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) If it's the opposing Attack Step, you can [Contract Advent] this card from the Hand, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. For each Red symbol you control, this "Exhaustion effect" exhausts +1 bodies. (Max. +2)

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "NEXT" family Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
